hours_model.learn: First contact: read the module, take notes, build the formula-sheet entries.
hours_model.practice: End-of-module and question-bank sets, timed, with the error log filled in.
hours_model.review: Two spaced revisions (flashcards + redo misses), not a third full read.
hours_model.note: Hours are CFA-only. English (1 h/day) sits on top, inside the weekly budget.
